When someone rings the doorbell, unlocks the door or is detected by a camera, the display lights up automatically with a live feed and a voice alert, so you know who is there instantly.
View your entire property at a glance through four simultaneous live feeds, with near-instant access to any stream the moment something happens.
Past events are downloaded automatically to local storage, so you can replay any moment with no delay and no buffering.
Using facial and package recognition powered by HomeBase 3, the display compiles daily summaries with statistics and video recordings for quick insight.
The 8-inch touchscreen is straightforward enough for children and older family members, and flexible to place wherever you need it.
